information.description:
In essence, Matóns are cold-hearted bodyguards that defend the gang’s special interests. Whether that be escorting smaller groups in the streets or defending higher-ups, a Matón’s cyber-armor and melee prowess helps make absolutely sure that nobody gets too close to cause trouble.

From Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis (Valentinos).

Cost: 3,000eb (Luxury) for Subdermal Armors SP13 and higher.

A dense, layered microplating that boosts the stopping power of cybernetic armor, giving extra bite against blunt force and ballistics.

Skinweave/Subdermal Armor Cyberware Enhancement. Increases the enhanced armor’s SP by 1. Cannot increase the SP of Dragoon Plating.

NOTE: Credit to the From the Ashes LC for the idea on changes to this item.

Enhances: Skinweave or Subdermal Armor
Option Slots: 0 (Cyberware Enhancement)

Foundry notes:

  • Corgo prices this by the armor's SP, so it comes as two items.
  • Change the SP on the armor item by hand; an upgrade installed in cyberware can't do it.
